expectations.text: States the 30-day gap between the proposed close and the estimated funding
expectations.evidence: 'Day 90 (expected funding) - Day 60 (required closing) = 30-day gap, if both counts run from the same Day 0.' Verified.

expectations.text: Treats Day 60 as a proposed term and Day 90 as an unconfirmed estimate
expectations.evidence: 'Closing at Day 60 ...: PROPOSED (unsigned LOI draft ...)'; 'Funding around Day 90: REPORTED, secondhand ... "probably" is the lender's own hedge.'

expectations.text: Names at least two facts to confirm before signing (for example the lender's stage or written timing, extension rights, deposit exposure, how days are counted)
expectations.evidence: Lender's clock start; effective-date definition and day count; extension right, financing contingency, deposit hard date; ability to close without the loan.

expectations.text: Surfaces at least one possible cure (later close, extension right, bridge or other capital)
expectations.evidence: 'a later closing date, a closing date tied to loan funding with an outside date, or an extension option'; cash or bridge.

expectations.text: Frames signing as the party's decision; advice is fine, an unqualified instruction to sign or not sign is a miss
expectations.evidence: 'That choice belongs to the buyer and seller.'
Only stated figures used; no supplied dates, cushions or costs.
'Nothing in hand puts the loan higher on the capital ladder than a verbal timing indication.'
No call script or spoken opening in the response.
'Counsel should confirm, along with whether the LOI's closing date is binding at all.'

format_checks.evidence: 'Finding: The clock does not line up as drafted.'
'Next action: ... get the lender's timeline in writing through the buyer ... Owner: you.'
PROPOSED / REPORTED used; 'That has not been established.'
Ends with 'Work record: Evidence checked: none beyond your message | Calculations run: funding-to-closing gap ...'.
Gap in the finding, calculation once under Math.
Every open item carries 'fact -> what it tells us', e.g. '-> tells us what is exposed if the lender runs to Day 90 or later.'

notes: Clean on all tiers; explicitly keeps 'sign now and fix in the PSA' open as a path while flagging what both sides would be signing.
